title: License record by holder
summary: The license record's header, holder card and origin card for the two holder states licenses.detail doesn't draw: Waiting (Tomás Okafor, made by hand) and Floating (a key from the Controller bundle batch), covering the By hand and Key batch origins.
compare: A board of two page slices (.board.cols-1), each the record's header, tabs, holder card and origin card on the same rail layout as licenses.detail.
Waiting: 'Tomás Okafor' with 'Waiting for sign-in' in the info tone; tomas@example.com and the id; Tier: Standard ▾, Resend invitation (primary) and ⋯ (Change email, Change tier, Revoke).

Invitation card: 'Moves into his account at his first sign-in with this email, verified.' and Change email…; Sent Oct 2 (Not opened yet), Devices none until he signs in; foot: 'Change email sends a new invitation; the old link stops working.'
By hand origin: Created Oct 2, 2026 by Ada Lovelace, the reason, 'Access rules never change it.', Open Activity.

Floating: titled by the masked key in mono with Active; the Floating pill and the license id; Tier: Standard ▾, Assign to a person (primary) and ⋯ (Change tier, Disable key, Revoke). No email anywhere.
Anyone with the key: Key (only its hash is kept), First used Oct 6, 2026 on Studio-PC · Windows 11 · DJDL 4.2.0, Devices 1 of 5, Library (adding the key moves the license into that account).
Key batch origin: Controller bundle · Oct 2026, created Oct 6, 2026 by Ada Lovelace, 41 of 200 used, and Disable unused keys turning off the other 159; Open batch.

designReview.reviewer: Spacing and content pass against the products.overview and products.home references, all four sizes in both themes
designReview.verdict: Spacing and content pass: real page slices on the kit board with kv-rows; 0 screen spacing; the holder state said once.

findings.issue: A custom frame and fact grid (18 spacing declarations) with a 24px title off the type scale.
Waiting was said four times (status, pill, card title, invitation line) and 'Anyone with the key' twice; 'Since' and 'Invitation sent' repeated the cards.
findings.resolution: Status once in the header, the holder card names the rest.

findings.issue: Devices rows duplicated the tab count; mechanism sentences repeated.
findings.resolution: Devices rows removed from the Invitation and Floating cards; the Library row and the 'old link stops working' footer removed; heads are .card-head.h56; tab strip is .tabs.scroller. The label and value already sit side by side on phone for short values.
